FundPanel.title: Fund Vault
FundPanel.intro: Open your own banco to third-party capital. LPs deposit USDT and get quote-shares back; you run the strategy, the keeper quotes automatically, and you earn a performance fee on any profit — split with the platform. Your own single-owner Placer Vault (if any) is untouched by this.
FundPanel.timedOut: Still waiting for confirmation on-chain — check your wallet's Activity tab; do not cancel it. Reload once it confirms.
FundPanel.illiquidError: Not enough liquid balance right now — some capital is locked in open offers.

volume.label: Volume Dominator
volume.description: Best odds. Maximizes the number of incoming bets.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Standard house edge. Good mix of volume and profit.

safe.label: Safe Bank
safe.description: Conservative odds. Lower volume, highest profit margin per bet.

FundPanel.performanceFeeDesc: Your cut of LP profit above the high-water mark, crystallized on-chain. Platform takes a share of this fee, not a separate cost to you.
FundPanel.maxSizeDesc: Caps the liability of any single offer, enforced on-chain — protects LP capital from one oversized bet.
FundPanel.approvedLpsDesc: Only approved addresses can deposit. Revoking never blocks an existing LP from withdrawing their own position.
FundPanel.kycVerifiedNote: Verified — the keeper can quote once activated below.
FundPanel.kycPendingNote: Under manual review (testnet — no Sumsub integration yet). Check back soon.

FundPanel.singleCapErr: Set a "Max Size Per Bet" cap on-chain before activating the keeper — it protects LP capital from a single oversized bet.
